name: Weld Penetration Depth from Heat Input (Parametric)
description: Weld penetration depth is a parametric function of heat input: d_pen = k × H_weld. ZeMA heat input uncertainty propagates through this affine formula to penetration depth uncertainty.

elements.name: Welding Heat Input
elements.description: Energy input per unit weld length, combining voltage, current and travel speed.

elements.name: Maximum Penetration Depth
elements.description: Weld procedure WPS-42: tight maximum penetration for thin-wall joint [threshold adjusted to 0.599 for realistic partial-overlap consistency check]

consistency_relations.upr_sigma: σ(H) = F·H + f where F = k = 4.8 mm²/kJ, f = 0; CZ_dpen = [c_dpen ± g_dpen] = [H_c*4.8 ± H_g*4.8]
consistency_relations.upr_description: Parametric UPR: penetration depth CZ is affine image of heat input CZ through empirical d_pen=k×H formula.
